subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt one of the linked fork PRs, or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug remains valid and narrow, but the issue already carries `clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr`, live fork closing references, and prior duplicate same-repository attempts, so the next fix path needs maintainer ownership rather than another automatic branch.

options.title: Sponsor fresh same-repo fix
options.body: Close or treat the fork PRs as source context and queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with regression tests and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh a fork PR
options.body: Pick the better open fork candidate, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor fresh same-repo fix
recommendation.body: Close or treat the fork PRs as source context and queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with regression tests and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent Feishu send/outbound history closest to the affected code path.
